purpose: Verified no naming scope; slate remains.
Cross-repository scope ticket list; no shared project.
Scope resolves to multiple milestone identities; hide milestone.
Current approved revision 2 removes withdrawn ticket 3.
Unapproved slate is not a progress set.
Corrupt issue state cannot become an open count.
Open and closed native blockers; only open blocker is shown.
Missing replay record is unsupported, not an empty membership.
Issue identity does not match the requested source key.
Nearest-parent read failed; directly recorded milestone remains available.
Project-only scope resolves the explicit project reference without a repository.
Case matrix derived from captured epic/milestone URLs. Each case names its exact one-field patch; absent/malformed destinations must be null and valid absolute HTTP(S) destinations must be preserved.
Each case carries its exact patch from recorded baseline data. All run/claim scenarios are derived, not operational captures.
